$comment: Every label the issue forms and teamrig's import use. Type labels are set by the issue forms; priority, area and state labels need triage rights, so only maintainers and the GitHub watcher set them.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Type: something the relay does wrong

labels.name: task
labels.description: Type: work to do that is not a bug or a new capability

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Type: a new capability or a change in behaviour

labels.name: design
labels.description: Design talk: discussion only, not work to take until it is agreed

labels.name: area:relay
labels.description: Area: the relay server and what it forwards

labels.name: area:crypto
labels.description: Area: sealing, keys and pairing of a user's machines

labels.name: area:docs
labels.description: Area: the docs and the README

labels.name: needs-format
labels.description: State: a section of the issue form is missing or empty

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: State: another issue or pull request already covers this

labels.name: teamrig
labels.description: State: accepted, so teamrig imports it as a task
